from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):\n            if row[c] == 7 and row[c - 1] == 7:\n                continue\n            if row[c - 1] == 7 and row[c + 1] == 7:\n                out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
path=program_dir/'task-b7e40178.py'
path.write_text(source)
# Reproduce demo using sparse positions stated in the received pair, with each background row initialized to 9.
demo_in=[[9]*27 for _ in range(28)]
demo_rows={0:[18,20],7:[5,7,9],11:[5,7],16:[15,17,19,21,23],24:[1,3]}
for r,cs in demo_rows.items():
    for c in cs: demo_in[r][c]=7
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_b7e40178',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo_out=mod.transform(demo_in)
demo_expected={0:[19],7:[6,8],11:[6],16:[16,18,20,22],24:[2]}
assert all([c for c,v in enumerate(demo_out[r]) if v==2]==cs for r,cs in demo_expected.items())
assert sum(v==2 for row in demo_out for v in row)==sum(map(len,demo_expected.values()))
# Build test input and evaluate via the saved program.
test=[[5]*27 for _ in range(18)]
test_rows={5:[3,5],15:[9,11,13,15,17,19,21],17:[14,16,18]}
for r,cs in test_rows.items():
    for c in cs: test[r][c]=7
answer=mod.transform(test)
print('demo reproduction passed; file:',path)
print(answer)
